title: LookTerrain
description: Data file content/look/terrain.json: how the island grid is drawn (B2 R18-R20): palette colours per biome, for cliffs and the ground under water, the water surfaces and the detail levels of the chunks. Ids refer to content/look/palette.json. Presentation only, not part of the hash. Values are placeholders.

biome_colors.description: Ground colour of each biome (biome id from content/world/biomes.json, colour id from the palette).

bed_color.description: Palette colour of the ground under water.

slope_shade_permille.description: How much steep ground is darkened towards the cliff colour (0 = not at all, 1000 = fully).

slope_shade_gain.description: How fast slope shading rises with steepness: (1 - normal.y) times this, capped at 1, then scaled by slope_shade_permille.

open_sea_size_factor.description: Size of the open sea plane around the map, as a multiple of the map's width and depth.

TerrainCliffs.description: Where the ground is drawn as a vertical rock wall instead of a slope (D576, TL #19553): only between two neighbouring cells whose heights differ by at least min_drop_mm and whose higher cell belongs to one of these biomes. Everywhere else the corner heights blend across the drop, so hills and terraces are smooth slopes. Placeholder values.

biomes.description: Biome ids (content/world/biomes.json) whose cells form rock walls where they stand above a neighbour.

min_drop_mm.description: Smallest height difference (millimetres) between neighbouring cells that becomes a rock wall.

TerrainWater.description: Palette colours of the water surfaces and the depth (in height units) from which water counts as deep.

swamp_max_units.description: Fresh water this shallow (height units) is drawn as murky swamp.

stream_shore_lift_mm.description: Where a stream borders dry ground its edge comes down to the ground and lies this far above it (millimetres), so the edge closes against the bank without flickering into it.

stream_width_m.description: Width of a stream band in metres: streams are drawn as smooth bands along their centre line (A1456); the generator makes them two cells wide.

stream_smoothing.description: Rounds of corner cutting (Chaikin) along a stream's centre line; each round doubles the points (0 = the cell-centre polyline).

TerrainWaterShader.description: Parameters of the fresh water shader (game/shaders/island_water.gdshader): light stripes that travel along the flow of streams, a slow shimmer on still water.

stripe_scale.description: Stripes per metre along the flow.

stripe_speed.description: How fast the stripes travel (stripes per second).

shimmer_speed.description: Speed of the shimmer on still water.

TerrainDetail.description: Detail levels of the terrain chunks (B2 R18): each chunk has one ground mesh per level, built once from the base grid (it never changes at run time). A coarser level merges blocks of plain dry land into a few triangles within its tolerances and draws coast, banks, water and cliffs as the base grid does; the water is always drawn from the base grid. Godot switches between the levels by the camera distance to the chunk (visibility ranges, switched at until_m without fade, with a small hysteresis: the levels share their borders and differ only within the tolerances) and culls chunks outside the view.

levels.description: Levels from near to far: the first has cell_step 1 (the base grid); cell steps rise, each a divisor of the chunk size; every level but the last ends at until_m (rising), the last reaches to the horizon; coarser levels need max_error_mm and max_color_delta_permille.

sea_floor_margin_mm.description: Coarser levels merge open sea bed only where every merged corner lies at least this far (millimetres) below the sea surface, so the floor never shows through or flickers with the water.

switch_margin_m.description: Hysteresis of the switch between two levels (metres): a shown level stays up to twice this beyond until_m, so chunks do not pop back and forth while the camera eases; a hidden one appears exactly at until_m. Levels must lie more than four margins apart.

cell_step.description: Edge length in grid cells of the blocks this level may merge (1 = every cell of the base grid).

until_m.description: Camera distance to the chunk (metres) up to which this level is drawn; missing on the last level.

max_error_mm.description: Largest height difference (millimetres) of a merged block from the base grid; blocks that would differ more stay at full detail.

max_color_delta_permille.description: Largest colour difference per channel (permille) of a merged block from the base grid; blocks that would differ more stay at full detail.
